annotation.title_clean: 95/216/EC: Commission Recommendation of 8 June 1995 concerning improvement of safety of existing lifts
annotation.title_en: 95/216/EC: Commission Recommendation of 8 June 1995 concerning improvement of safety of existing lifts
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 134
annotation.summary_en: 1995 European Commission recommendation urging Member States to maintain and improve the safety of existing lifts, using ten listed safety principles in an annex, such as car doors, presence detectors, emergency lighting and alarm links. It concerns elevators, not AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States should ensure satisfactory maintenance of existing lifts
Safety improvements should follow the ten principles in the Annex
Standards EN 81-1 and EN 81-2 may be applied for numerical values
Measures: door fitting, presence detectors, emergency lighting, alarm links, anti-uncontrolled-movement devices
Member States may take further measures if safety demands
